_about: Halloween 2026 - the list of games. THE ONE PLACE to add, rename or describe a game.
The app reads this file when it starts and makes one button per game in the bottom panel.
There are five slots, game0 to game4. Each slot is the folder games/<slot>/ with an index.html inside.
A game's author fills in their slot's entry here and puts their files in that slot's folder. Nothing else changes.
game0 is the HOME game: shown at start and after the Home button. It gets no button.
Fields: slot = folder name (fixed), title = shown on the button and in the top panel,
author = who made it, description = one line about it (not shown yet).
More fields will be added later, when games start talking to the app (scores, settings, sound).
JSON cannot hold comments, which is why this _about block exists. The app ignores it.
